recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR-34373. If the later terminology concern about the example value set for Specimen.feature.type is filed and accepted, handle it under that separate Jira rather than by reopening this already-applied element-addition issue.
issue_request: FHIR-34373 was a Published FHIR-core Specimen change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to add Specimen.feature for pathology specimen markings/landmarks. The final resolution requested a 0..* backbone element with required Specimen.feature.type CodeableConcept and required Specimen.feature.description string children.
initial_application: The change was applied through the FHIR-34373 pull request history in January 2022. Commit 7c3decd64c899b8ba8389a8ca2f06601df55a45e added the Specimen.feature backbone, and PR branch follow-up commits ending at d4b5c54ff295272d2abc11d5a8e93c2eedbb42ea corrected the description child to string and adjusted wording before merge commit 557826698254f51dea333c1514fe492e909d6a78.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml is current build-scope source. OO Confluence minutes from 2021-11-22 and 2021-11-29 confirm the specimen-marking use case, the shift to a backbone element with two required children, and the 7-0-2 persuasive-with-modification vote. A later Zulip terminology thread questioned the example body-site binding for feature.type, but no final FHIR-core Jira decision was found that would make a seed-scope source edit safe here.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already has Specimen.feature 0..* BackboneElement, Specimen.feature.type 1..1 CodeableConcept, and Specimen.feature.description 1..1 string.
